name: Vaibhav Barman
label: AI Engineer | LLM Applications, RAG & AI Agents
tagline: I build AI agents that check their own work: LLM apps, RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems, often on local models.
summary: AI engineer building LLM applications, RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems in Python, with a focus on local models, structured outputs and evaluation. I study Computer Science at BITS Pilani (B.Sc., expected 2027) and learn by shipping: ten open-source projects since August 2026.

projects.title: GitCommit AI
projects.summary: An agentic, repository-aware Git commit assistant (git ai-commit) that learns how a repository writes commits and drafts messages in that style, checked by a deterministic critic before you see them.
highlights: Detects the repository's commit convention and style profile from recent history, with a confidence score.
A critic loop checks each draft against deterministic rules plus an LLM faithfulness check, and regenerates until it passes.
Never stages files and refuses to commit if the staging area or HEAD changed while it was working.
Supports Anthropic, Gemini, Hugging Face, OpenAI, OpenRouter and Ollama (local or remote), with an evaluation harness that replays your own history.

projects.title: LocalForge-AI
projects.summary: An autonomous, local-first multi-agent software development and QA engine built with LangGraph and Ollama. It coordinates task specification, code generation, execution, and repair workflows on a local machine.
highlights: Uses specialized agents for specification, implementation, and verification stages.
Feeds concrete execution, linting, and test failures back into a code-repair loop.
Designed for offline runtime with locally hosted open-weight models through Ollama.

projects.title: PromptRoute
projects.summary: An LLM-native travel itinerary planner that generates structured, time-slotted travel plans using a local Ollama model and an interactive web interface.
highlights: Explores a Backend-as-a-Prompt architecture that returns structured JSON without a conventional application server or database.
Connects local model output to an interactive web frontend.
Designed for local inference without cloud API keys or per-token inference costs.

projects.title: AI Payment Recovery Agent
projects.summary: An AI agent prototype that classifies failed payments, selects a recovery strategy, simulates outcomes, and adapts later decisions using historical performance.
highlights: Uses LLM reasoning to classify payment-failure context and choose a recovery action.
Records simulated outcomes and feeds strategy-performance history into subsequent decisions.
Combines a web dashboard with a FastAPI backend, SQLite, and a Groq-hosted LLM.

projects.title: Odyssey RAG
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented question-answering system that answers questions about Homer's The Odyssey using relevant passages retrieved from the source text.
highlights: Processes a source document into overlapping chunks and retrieves relevant passages using embedding similarity.
Uses Gemini embeddings and Gemini for grounded answer generation.
Includes retrieval inspection and evaluation with metrics such as Recall@K and Mean Reciprocal Rank.

projects.title: Local YouTube Video Summarizer
projects.summary: A privacy-focused tool that transcribes YouTube video audio and creates concise summaries using Whisper and a locally hosted language model through Ollama.
highlights: Uses Whisper for audio transcription and Ollama for local LLM summarization.
Provides command-line and Gradio web-interface workflows.
Keeps transcription and summarization on the user's own machine.

projects.title: GNews MCP Server
projects.summary: A Model Context Protocol server that exposes news search and top-headline retrieval tools for AI assistants.
highlights: Implements MCP tools for searching news articles and retrieving top headlines.
Supports configurable language, country, category, date range, sorting, and result limits.
Built in Python with FastMCP and managed with uv.

projects.title: ApplyIQ
projects.summary: An AI-powered job application intelligence platform that compares a candidate's resume with a job description to surface ATS compatibility, missing skills, and potential recruiter concerns.
highlights: Integrates Gemini-based resume and job-description analysis into a full-stack application.
Pairs a web frontend with a Python FastAPI backend.
Includes PostgreSQL persistence with SQLAlchemy and Alembic, input validation, prompt-injection defenses, and automated tests.

projects.title: Gemini Website Summarizer
projects.summary: A Python application that extracts readable content from a webpage and uses Google's Gemini API to generate a concise Markdown summary.
highlights: Fetches webpages with Requests and parses readable content with BeautifulSoup.
Uses the Google Gen AI SDK to generate summaries.
Loads API credentials from local environment configuration.

projects.title: Spendly
projects.summary: A lightweight personal expense tracker built with Flask and SQLite, developed end to end with Claude Code as an agentic coding workflow.
highlights: Server-rendered Flask app with Jinja2 templates and a shared base layout.
SQLite persistence with parameterized queries kept in a single database module.
Built with Claude Code using a project CLAUDE.md, custom skills and subagents for exploration and test verification.
Tested with pytest and pytest-flask.
